snippet.title: Time Breaking: Dino Breach (Dino Crisis inspired game) - Kickstarter trailer
snippet.description:
Time Breaking: Dino Breach is an isometric survival horror experience inspired by Dino Crisis. Experience the desperate struggle of Kate Jeong, a woman who goes back in time, facing dangerous dinosaurs, determined to change the fate of someone she loves deeply.

With gameplay that echoes the intense survival dynamics and tension of the classic Dino Crisis, Time Breaking: Dino Breach offers a mix of action, puzzle-solving and moments of pure suspense as you explore claustrophobic research centers and prehistoric jungles populated by deadly dinosaurs.

Time Breaking: Dino Breach page is now available on Steam. You can add it to your wishlist ❤, demo will also be available soon!🦖

STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3407680/Time_Breaking_Dino_Breach
Support us on  KICKSTARTER: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/digitalyarts/time-breaking-dino-breach
